falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 75% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a sustained rally from lower levels; a break to new highs this quickly would mean the structural setup was not comparable and the bottom-call pattern failed to produce the expected choppy consolidation or lower-low sequence

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression to pre-stress levels would falsify the bottom-formation thesis because August 2024's bottom was accompanied by elevated volatility that persisted for weeks; rapid vol normalization indicates the market never priced the stress this pattern requires

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would invalidate the verdict because the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields in a 3.90%-4.20% range and was driven by growth-scare positioning; a flight-to-quality bid driving yields sharply lower would signal a fundamentally different macro regime (recession fear rather than soft-landing repricing), breaking the pattern's causal logic
